title: Monster Mansion released
text: The Monster Mansion came out for 13,000 Bucks. It has four levels, and its ten matching furniture pieces are sold separately.

title: Fairytale Castle released
text: The Fairytale Castle came out for 8,000 Bucks. It is a four-story house, and its ten matching furniture pieces are sold separately.

title: Beehive House released
text: The Beehive House arrived with the Pollinator Season update for 5,450 Bucks. It is not a Bee Pass reward.

title: Final-chance Robux sale
text: Adopt Me ran a final-chance Robux sale that included the Modern Mansion, Celebrity Mansion, Soccer Stadium, the School and Hospital bundle and the Fossil Isle bundle. Those houses are no longer sold and can only be traded for.

title: Christmas Pudding House event reward
text: The Christmas Pudding House was a free reward for completing 15 pet needs in the Winter Event. It left the game on January 5, 2026, and can only be traded for now.

title: Halloween Hotel released
text: The Halloween Hotel came out for 7,000 Bucks with the Halloween House update. It has three levels: a ground floor, a second floor and a basement.

title: Moon House released
text: The Moon House came out for 4,000 Bucks. It is a single room of rocky terrain with a portal, and a red button inside switches low gravity on and off.

title: Ice Cream House released
text: The Ice Cream House came out for 2,150 Bucks with a set of ice cream furniture. It has two floors.

title: Soccer Stadium released
text: The Soccer Stadium came out in the Soccer update as a Robux house with two floors and seven rooms. It was part of the April 2026 final-chance Robux sale, and can only be traded for now.

title: Last Chance House Sale
text: Seven houses went on sale and were removed one per day from June 8 to June 14, 2024: Mansion, Cozy Cabin, Biodome Home, Ruler's Castle, Pirate Ship House, Eco Natural Earth House and Mermaid Mansion.

title: House trading added
text: Adopt Me added house trading on May 31, 2024. A player needs a trade license and at least two houses, and a house can be traded for anything except another house.

title: Expandable Dino House released
text: The Expandable Dino House came with the Fossil Isle Returns Bundle during Fossil Isle Excavation, along with the Legendary Prehistoric Car. It was part of the April 2026 final-chance Robux sale.

title: Korean House released
text: The Korean House came out in the second week of the Lunar New Year event for 2,200 Bucks.

title: Queenslander House released
text: The Queenslander House came out for 1,650 Bucks, with a matching furniture pack sold separately.

title: Expandable houses added
text: Adopt Me added its first three expandable houses, each with a furniture pack. Expansions are bought separately with Bucks, and future houses may come with the feature.
